garments_provenance_check.name: garments_provenance_check
garments_provenance_check.value: ("app"."garments"."origin"='custom' AND "app"."garments"."template_key" IS NULL) OR ("app"."garments"."origin"='standard' AND "app"."garments"."template_key" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."garments"."template_key" IN ('shirt','blouse','trouser'))

master_services_provenance_check.name: master_services_provenance_check
master_services_provenance_check.value: ("app"."master_services"."origin"='custom' AND "app"."master_services"."template_key" IS NULL) OR ("app"."master_services"."origin"='standard' AND "app"."master_services"."template_key" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."master_services"."template_key" IN ('new-stitching','alteration'))
